name: Destroy Yoshi
description: When Mario rides Yoshi ($187A), Yoshi is destroyed in a puff of smoke, and so is whatever he holds in his mouth ($18AC); Mario lands on his feet. Adapted from the Destroy Yoshi block (SMWC 31301), with its SA-1 fixes; not tried in an emulator by us. Yoshi's slot comes from $18E2, and the puff and stars are made by the game's routine at $07FC3B.
author: BlockCreator
